hint: You're offline. Pages you opened before can still be read and edited; changes sync when the connection is back.
signOutUnsynced: Some pages have edits that haven't reached the server yet. Signing out removes them from this browser. Sign out anyway?

page.heading: You're offline
page.body: Leafdesk can't reach the server right now. Pages you opened on this device are listed below and open from this browser's copy.
page.empty: No pages are saved on this device yet. Pages you open while online are kept for offline use.

stale.title: Leafdesk has been updated
stale.body: This tab still runs the previous version, so its pages have stopped syncing. Reload to continue. Edits you made here are kept and sent after the reload.
stale.offlineBody: This tab runs a different version than the one this browser last used, so its pages have stopped syncing. Reload once you're back online. Edits you made here are kept and sent then.

keep.hint: Download this page to this device and keep it up to date, so it opens without a connection
keep.subpagesHint: Also download up to {max} pages under it
keep.rowsHint: Also download up to {max} of its rows with their pages

settings.description: Pages downloaded here open without a connection and are kept up to date while Leafdesk is open. Offline copies belong to this device and browser: other devices keep their own, and signing out removes them from this one.
settings.favoritesHint: Your favorites in each workspace are downloaded to this device and kept up to date.
settings.storageUsed: {used} used in this browser, of {quota} it allows
settings.storageUnknown: This browser doesn't say how much storage is used.
settings.persisted: Kept persistently: the browser won't clear these copies on its own.
settings.notPersisted: Not kept persistently: the browser may clear these copies when space runs low.
settings.pagesDescription: Turn on “Available offline” in a page's menu, or in the menu beside a page in the sidebar.
settings.none: No pages are downloaded on this device yet.
settings.favoriteOnly: Kept because it's a favorite. Remove the star, or turn off keeping favorites offline.
settings.recent: {count, plural, =0 {No recently opened pages are kept.} one {# recently opened page is also kept on this device.} other {# recently opened pages are also kept on this device.}}
settings.removeAllDescription: Downloaded and recently opened pages are removed from this device. They open from the server again.
settings.removeAllBody: Every offline copy on this device is removed. While favorites are kept offline, they are downloaded again.
settings.removeAllUnsent: {count, plural, one {# page has edits} other {# pages have edits}} that haven't reached the server yet. Removing the copies loses them.
